name: brag-doc
description: Cluster your git/PR contributions in any repo into analysis docs: a theme overview plus per-topic deep dives from PR diffs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your git/PR history into contribution analysis docs
interface.longDescription: Collects the PRs and direct commits you authored in the current repo, clusters them into themes, and writes an overview plus per-theme deep dives backed by real PR diffs. Deep dives can then be distilled into resume contribution entries.
defaultPrompt: Scan my contributions in this repo and build a theme overview.
Deep-dive the themes from my brag-doc overview.
Turn my brag-doc deep dives into resume contribution entries.
